title: Talarico’s past comments agreeing Christians are villains won’t win Texas: Joe Concha
text:
A resurfaced interview with Democratic Senate nominee James Talarico won’t help the candidate win in Texas during the midterm elections, Washington Examiner columnist Joe Concha said on Fox News’s Saturday in America.

“If he’s running for Senate in California or Minnesota, then maybe that stuff flies a little better,” Concha said on Saturday.
